title: ProductDeactivated
description: Emitted by the Catalog service when a product is no longer sellable (soft delete / archived). Consumers should hide it from menus and reject new orders for it. Minor/patch evolution stays in this file via schemaVersion (ADR 0005); breaking changes go to a new events/vN/ path (ADR 0007).

eventId.description: = messageId do outbox; chave de deduplicação at-least-once
